title: Nice Crunchy German Sausage Grill
description: A kid-friendly German dish featuring Branston pickle, this recipe is rich, crumbly, and perfect for a low-fat friendly meal. It's a great option for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped Branston pickle, sliced onion, and sliced bell pepper.
Add the bread crumbs, beaten egg, salt, and pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Place the German sausage links on a plate or tray and brush with a little water.
Roll each sausage link in the bread crumb mixture to coat evenly.
Place the coated sausage links on the preheated grill and cook for about 5 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Serve the grilled sausage hot with additional Branston pickle on the side, if desired.
Let the sausage rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
